original.statement: The `s3.sse-encryption` configuration key is removed in Loki 3.0.0; use `sse.type` instead to configure SSE type, as AWS now defaults encryption of all buckets to SSE-S3.

decision.reason: [ev-c8a8a9c16d41] says "`s3.sse-encryption` is removed" and "Use `sse.type` to set SSE type", under the upgrade-guide section "Deprecated configuration options are removed". That supports a removed change for a configuration option at path s3.sse-encryption, with sse.type as its replacement. Other items in that section explicitly call their options CLI flags (e.g. [ev-f5a61f629314]), but this one does not. So config-key is the family the text supports, and the name is copied exactly.
